script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - NIGHT

JOSH (mid-20s, ambitious, restless), dressed in a suit and tie, paces around his small apartment, staring at a blank canvas. He clutches a paintbrush in one hand and a cup of coffee in the other.

JOSH
(sighs)
This is it. The moment. I've got the perfect apartment, the perfect job, the perfect lifestyle. But something's missing. I want more. I want to create something that matters.

He stops pacing and looks at the canvas. A blank stare.

JOSH
(to himself)
What can I create that doesn't involve violence or harming others?

Suddenly, there's a knock on the door.

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS

Josh opens the door to reveal his old high school friend, MARK (mid-20s, carefree, adventurous). He's carrying a backpack and wearing a bright red hoodie.

MARK
(grinning)
Hey, long time no see, Josh! How have you been?

JOSH
(sighs)
I've been better. I've been trying to find my purpose in life. I've got this job, this apartment, but I feel empty.

MARK
(laughs)
Empty, huh? Well, I've got an idea that might help you out. You know that abandoned amusement park down the street?

JOSH
(surprised)
Yeah, I've heard of it. It's been closed for years.

MARK
Exactly. I've been meaning to check it out for a while now. I was thinking, why don't we turn it into something new and exciting? A community art project, perhaps?

JOSH
(excited)
That's a great idea! But how are we going to do it? We can't just break in and start painting without permission.

MARK
(smiling)
That's where you come in, my ambitious friend. We'll present our idea to the city council and ask for their support. We can't let this opportunity pass us by.

INT. CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS - DAY

Josh and Mark stand before the city council, nervously presenting their idea to reopen the abandoned amusement park as a community art project.

COUNCILMEMBER 1
(skeptical)
An abandoned amusement park? That's a big project. Are you sure you can handle it?

JOSH
(confident)
Absolutely. We'll enlist the help of local artists, businesses, and volunteers to bring this project to life. It'll not only be a beautiful and unique attraction, but it'll also serve as a symbol of community pride and collaboration.

The council members exchange glances, impressed by Josh's passion and determination.

COUNCILMEMBER 2
(nods)
Very well. We'll grant you the permission and support you need to turn this project into a reality.

INT. ABANDONED AMPUTEUR PARK - NIGHT

Josh and Mark, along with a team of volunteers, work tirelessly to transform the abandoned amusement park into a vibrant community art project.

JOSH
(excitedly)
This is it, Mark. We're making a difference. We're creating something that matters.

MARK
(smiling)
I'm glad you're finding your purpose, Josh. It's about time.

As they work, the night sky lights up with the promise of a new beginning.

FADE OUT.

THE END
